## 2026

**Monday 5th October 2026 — Tony Short**

<details class="abstract"><summary>Click to expand abstract</summary>
Recurrence of finite quantum systems

*As a finite quantum system evolves, different initial states will evolve very differently. However, it is possible to find a time at which all states return arbitrarily close to their initial configuration. We obtain bounds on the time for this recurrence, by linking it to the mathematical problem of approximating real numbers by rationals.*

*(based on arXiv:2604.14995)*
